definitions.explanation: The fleshy, spore-bearing fruiting body of a fungus, often umbrella-shaped, with some varieties being edible.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}は{茸|きのこ}{狩|が}りの{季節|きせつ}だ。
examples.english: Autumn is the season for mushroom hunting.
examples.notes: 茸狩り is the activity of gathering wild mushrooms

examples.japanese: {茸|きのこ}を{鍋|なべ}に{入|い}れる。
{毒|どく}{茸|きのこ}に{気|き}をつけてください。
examples.english: Please be careful of poisonous mushrooms.

notes:
Also written as キノコ. Common edible mushrooms:
- しいたけ/{椎茸|しいたけ} (shiitake)
- しめじ (shimeji)
- えのき/{榎茸|えのきだけ} (enoki)
- まいたけ/{舞茸|まいたけ} (maitake)
- エリンギ (king trumpet mushroom)
- なめこ (nameko - slimy mushroom)
- マッシュルーム (button mushroom)
- {松茸|まつたけ} (matsutake - prized, expensive)

Dangerous varieties:
- {毒|どく}{茸|きのこ} (poisonous mushrooms)
- ベニテングタケ (fly agaric)
- ツキヨタケ (common in accidents)

Mushroom-related:
- {茸|きのこ}{狩|が}り (mushroom hunting)
- {茸|きのこ}{鍋|なべ} (mushroom hot pot)
- {干|ほ}し{椎茸|しいたけ} (dried shiitake)
